title: A viewfinder without glass, and sharing with stats
body: The viewfinder lost its gradient scrims; every readout now carries its own shadow. The corner marks grow amber when a photo is taken, then settle. In Cine they stay amber for the whole take and a red edge runs round the frame; held sideways, a header with the film name and a REC pill runs along the top.
The photo preview prints the recipe and film on the picture, with five figures along the bottom: ISO, white balance, DR, highlight and shadow.

Share now offers three choices: **Photo only**, **Card** (the photo on a dark band with the recipe, the film and those five figures) and **Overlay** (the preview's label burned in). Card and Overlay drop location data before sharing.

images.alt: A street photo on a dark card. Below it: City Neg 400, Lost Summer Neg, and a row reading ISO 160, WB AWB R+2 B−3, DR 400, Highlight −2, Shadow +1.5.
